page.overview:
Who is Muhammad Avdol?

Anime: Chris Tergliafera Alan Bravo Duda Ribeiro [https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=146192 Hermógenes Alonso]

Introduced as an Egyptian friend of Joseph Joestar, he joins the group on their journey to defeat DIO, providing knowledge and guidance about enemy Stand Users and local cultures along the way.

Avdol is a Stand User and wields the fire manipulating Stand, Magician's Red.

Avdol is an Egyptian man of above-average height and medium to heavy build.
